title: ChatGPT on Android and remote access

steps.headline: Android can connect a ChatGPT account alongside the other providers.
steps.changed: ChatGPT now appears with a Sign in with ChatGPT button when the app is using the phone's own backend. The same entry is available during first-time setup. At phone width, provider buttons sit below the account text instead of overlapping the names.
steps.notice: No need to disconnect Claude Code or OpenRouter. This reuses the existing desktop ChatGPT card, Claude Code account card and OpenRouter provider card.
steps.risk: The picture uses a fake account in the shared renderer. A real browser login on your phone is not verified, and this review does not install or update your phone app.

steps.path: Settings → Assistant settings → Cloud providers, with the host signed out of ChatGPT
steps.headline: Remote clients see ChatGPT and where to connect it.
steps.changed: The hidden card is now visible. Instead of an unusable sign-in button, it says: To connect ChatGPT, sign in on the host device.
steps.notice: Account visibility no longer depends on whether this screen can receive the browser sign-in callback. Existing desktop sign-in behavior stays unchanged.
steps.risk: Before reproduces the baseline source, not your installed build; its fake backend uses the old bridge's actual unsupported flag rather than the old mock's incorrect default.

steps.path: Settings → Assistant settings → Cloud providers, with the host already signed in
steps.headline: A connected host account shows its plan and usage remotely.
steps.changed: The ChatGPT card shows the host account, plan and usage bars instead of disappearing on remote clients. Its existing My account and Sign out controls remain available.
steps.notice: The connection belongs to the backend you are controlling. Switching between the phone's own backend and another device uses that backend's account support.
steps.risk: Usage and account details in these pictures are fixtures, not your real account. The same baseline reproduction caveat applies as on the previous step.
